check1.label: shared-method comparison, not an independent test: NAE and the account both impute status by a Borjas-style residual and use CBO's federal rates, so agreement cannot validate the account; only a disagreement is informative. Outcomes are 'finding' or 'no finding'.

income_per_household.rule: NAE's household income over its household count if the report states one, else over its count of Mexican immigrants lacking legal status (the account's value on the same denominator); finding if outside [0.80, 1.25] x the account's 2024 value times the central bridge; otherwise no finding

payroll_share.rule: NAE's (Social Security + Medicare) over household income, United States row; no finding if inside [0.85, 1.15] x S (statutory rates on all members' earnings, NAE's standard rule) or inside [0.85, 1.15] x S/2 (the same, halved by the filing discount); finding otherwise

state_shares.rule: D = total variation distance over NAE's listed states plus one 'rest' cell, NAE's shares of its United States row against the account's; no finding if D <= 0.08 and D < D(baseline); finding if D > 0.15 or D >= D(baseline); otherwise partial

federal_B_income_tax_over_income.note: reported only: NAE's federal column is reading A or B (reads Q3), so the reading-A bound decides

nas_first_generation_receipts_ratio.rule: hit if NAS is within 0.05 of both allocations (not blind)

nas_first_generation_outlays_ratio.rule: hit if NAS is within 0.05 of both allocations (not blind)

level.rule: TVD between the S-10 state shares and account_r1; hit if TVD <= 0.15 and TVD <= 0.8 x TVD(population); miss if TVD > 0.25 or TVD >= TVD(population); otherwise partial

slope.rule: WLS of ln(S10 share / account_r1) on the group's share of the state's uninsured person-years, weights account_r1, HC1 errors, with the expansion indicator for year Y (primary) and without; 95% CI contains 0 and excludes the alternative: consistent with the adopted key; contains the alternative and excludes 0: favors r = 0.7; contains both: no power; excludes both: miss

national.rule: hit if S-10 national line 30 over account_N(Y) is inside [0.8, 1.25]

check3.year_rule: latest cost-report year whose report count is at least 95% of the year before; the counts are read before any state total is formed
